_readme: Events and Multimedia Production, Version 1.1: the page's words and its media configuration, section by section (src/pages/work/events-video.astro and src/components/events/). Copy follows John's Combined Build Brief and the V1.1 delta brief (October 14, 2026) and the facts in his working log; no metric is published until it has been verified, and nothing here mentions an unannounced pilot, contract or Foundation discussions, investor diligence, data rooms or fundraising. Media slots name asset ids in src/data/assets.json: to replace a placeholder, drop the file in and approve its entry there; the layout never changes, because every slot already holds its final aspect ratio. Unapproved slots show a labeled placeholder in `npm run dev` only and nothing in a production build.

hero._hero: One program monitor and three reels, cut from the brief's ranges (assets.json has each reel's ranges). The control beneath the monitor shows only each reel's cue and name; `means` is read with each button by assistive technology and never shown. Q01 is the default; each reel plays through once and the program crossfades to the next; a reel the reader picks plays through, then the program carries on. Only the active reel plays, muted.
hero.headline: From live experience to lasting momentum.
hero.copy: I turn live opportunities into complete marketing systems, from sponsorship and on-site production to content, distribution, and the relationships that continue after the room clears.

transition._transition: Replaces the run of show (V1.1): the five stages as one phrase, revealed word by word over about seven tenths of a screen of scrolling, held, then straight into the activation. On small screens it breaks into two lines after `break` words.

activation.headline: The work starts before anyone enters the room.
activation.copy: Phi Labs sponsored the Sui Summit side event at ETHDenver in 2025 and 2026. Before the doors opened, I negotiated the sponsorship and its pricing, coordinated with the event host, sourced and priced the merchandise, worked with design on the screen animations and table assets, and planned how all of it would reach the people in the room.
activation._visual: An original 3D render of the activation (V1.1, replacing the schematic): a representative visualization, not a photograph, made for this page in Blender (scripts/render/; the spatial and lighting reference is reference/events-video/booth-render.png, never published). The television and the projected wall play their loops while the frame is in view; reduced motion, a data-saving preference, a small screen or no JavaScript keep the render with both screens on their poster frames.
activation.caption: A representative rendering of the activation, made for this page.

room.headline: Build the session. Fill the room. Extend its life.
room.copy: I organized and ran Bolt Liquidity’s presentation at Sui Summit in both 2025 and 2026. The recording here is from 2026, captured from the room as the session ran.

setup.headline: A compact setup. A full content system.
setup.copy: At ETHDenver I booked a production room at the venue and built a studio from what was on hand: a DJI camera and an iPhone on two tripods, a clip-on microphone, a laptop, the venue’s lighting and props. I wrote about 20 interview questions and directed Max McKendry through multiple takes. The finished explainers came from what happened after the session: the footage review, the takes I chose, and the edit direction I wrote for Bob van der Meer.

suifest.headline: If you cannot own the stage, create the moment everyone shares.
suifest.copy: Bolt was not a sponsor at Sui Fest, so the opportunity had to be made. I developed an interview concept, stepped in front of the camera as the interviewer, and spoke with established teams across the ecosystem, with Bolt as one voice among many. Every team in the piece was tagged, which gave each a reason to share it, and placed Bolt as a contributor to the ecosystem rather than a spectator at its edge.
suifest._video: Muted by default (V1.1): it plays silently while in view, with motion allowed, and the reader turns the sound on.

Cetus, Bluefin, 7K DeFi, NAVI & Astros, FlowX Finance, DoubleUp, Claynosaurz, and Talus

after.headline: Every event opens a longer conversation.
after.copy: The relationships an event starts are worth more than the event itself. On site I supported business development and product conversations, captured the people and their context for the CRM, and carried them into follow-up calls and continuing partner discussions. At ETHDenver 2025 I was part of the core team at an ecosystem team’s own event and stayed on to represent the company after my colleagues had left.

trail.label: Capture
trail.line: People and context into the CRM

after.outcome: Event-led relationship development contributed to subsequent conversations and integrations with ecosystem partners.

credits.what: Business-development follow-up, CRM capture, and relationship support

conclusion._conclusion: The third and final case study: no next case study follows; the page runs straight into Contact.
conclusion.headline: The room clears. The work keeps moving.
conclusion.copy: The strongest events do more than fill a room. They create content, relationships, conversations, and opportunities that continue long after the final session ends.
